race.comment: THE UNDERQUOTER (7) sets the standard second-up after a solid fourth at Kyneton, beaten four and a half lengths while covering ground early but still finishing well. His debut fifth in Open company at Kenso bodes well for this maiden, and the Price/Kent stable, with his lightly raced profile, add to the expectation. TEMPERED EDGE (5) has the best recent form, running second at Ballarat on heavy ground after an awkward start and some trouble near the 300m. His fifth at Warrnambool also held merit after being held up, and consistent 1600m form makes him a genuine threat. CHIP IN (6) is still learning but has progressed in two runs, only beaten three lengths at Sale, and should appreciate the mile now. BRIGHTHILL (1) resumes after trial work, showed promise in two soft-track runs last campaign and can run a forward race.
